description: This file defines a React component for the team sidebar in Mattermost, including team switching, drag-and-drop reordering, and permission-based UI elements.

classes.name: TeamSidebar
classes.description: React component managing the team sidebar, including team switching, drag-and-drop reordering, and permission-based UI elements.

methods.name: switchToPrevOrNextTeam
methods.description: Handles switching to the previous or next team based on keyboard input.

methods.name: switchToTeamByNumber
methods.description: Handles switching to a team based on number key input.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for team navigation shortcuts.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events to reset UI state.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates WebSocket active team on team change.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes team fetching and event listeners.

methods.name: onDragEnd
methods.description: Handles reordering of teams via drag-and-drop.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the team sidebar UI, including team buttons, join/create options, and plugins.
